resolved_findings.title: Missing test coverage for credential type reset skip logic
resolved_findings.description: The new `if (editing) return` guard prevents credential type auto-switching during edit mode, which is a critical behavioral change that protects loaded credential values from being discarded. However, there are no tests covering this specific scenario.
resolved_findings.resolution: Test coverage added in src/pages/integrations/components/SettingsForm/__tests__/SettingsForm.credentialTypeReset.test.tsx. Tests validate both edit mode (no reset) and create mode (reset) scenarios.

resolved_findings.title: Consider extracting detailed comment into documentation
resolved_findings.description: The inline comment explaining the `if (editing) return` logic is helpful but quite detailed (4 lines).
resolved_findings.resolution: Comment is appropriate for this subtle guard logic. Provides essential context for maintainability.

quality_gates_checked.notes: No security vulnerabilities identified. No hardcoded credentials, XSS risks, or unvalidated inputs.
Logic is sound. The guard correctly prevents credential reset during edit mode while preserving the behavior during create mode.
TypeScript types are properly maintained. The `editing` prop is correctly added to the useEffect dependency array.
No new error handling required for this change.
Early return in useEffect is a good performance practice.
Comprehensive test coverage added. Tests cover both edit mode (no reset) and create mode (reset) scenarios for the credential type guard.
Code is clear and well-commented. Inline comment provides valuable context.

changes_summary.description: Enables the Project field during edit mode by removing `editing` from the disabled condition. Adds a guard to prevent credential type auto-reset when project changes during editing, protecting loaded credential values from being discarded. Includes comprehensive test coverage.
